answer: Forging N identities costs N bonds, and any slashable offense burns the full bond, so fake clusters collapse against the horizon of profitability. Sybil resistance through stake-bonded reputation slot: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation before joining the meadow of active workers. Reputation accrues only via verified peer attestations tied to a unique grove of historical work, making cheap identity farming economically irrational. In practice, Agent0066 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
